title: Figure 42: NASP flight-test ground track for hypersonic cruise vehicle over CONUS
description: Map of the continental United States with orange ground tracks for Mach 15 and Mach 10 test flights originating at Edwards Air Force Base, annotated "Continuous 2g turn," "2g turn," "Start of deceleration/decent" and "1.75g acceleration for climb portion of flight," with cities and sites such as Seattle, Los Angeles, Denver, Chicago, Washington, Houston, Bonneville salt flats and White Sands range marked. The inset bears a NASP logo and headings "A typical circuit pattern for initial testing of a hypersonic Nasp-type vehicle" and "Flight-test ground track for hypersonic cruise vehicle." Caption: "Figure 42. Hypersonic Decelerating Descending Turns are Wide But Within a Reasonable CONUS Area if Mach 12 or Less."
